label: Takeaway
detail: Defiance went 15-34 and 8-20 in the WHAC in its second season in the league and didn't make the eight-team WHAC Tournament. No 2027 roster is posted; by class, players who can return had 78% of 2026 plate appearances and 75% of innings. Kanagy, a freshman outfielder, hit .440 and was second-team All-WHAC, Defiance's first all-conference pick in the league.

label: Method
detail: No 2027 roster is posted. Back means a 2026 player listed as a freshman, sophomore or junior. Listed seniors count as gone. A class listing doesn't confirm who returns.

label: Season
detail: 15-34 followed 15-35 in 2025. Defiance scored 294 runs and allowed 439, hit .285 with 24 homers and posted a 9.92 ERA, per its official stats. Defiance says the 294 runs and 78 doubles were program records. It played 42 of its 49 games away from home or at neutral sites and went 3-4 in games listed as home.

label: Postseason
detail: Defiance didn't reach the WHAC Tournament. Its season ended with a split at Rochester Christian on Apr 25, a 7-4 loss and an 18-10 win.

label: lu_proj
detail: Built from 2026 box scores, using only players who can return by class. Each spot goes to the returner with the most 2026 starts there. Order is by 2026 OPS, so small samples rank high. Set means 20 or more starts at the spot, Likely 8 or more.

label: lu_most
detail: A typical 2026 lineup, built from all 49 box scores. Each position goes to the player with the most starts there, using each player once and keeping as many of those starts as possible; the DH spot counts only starts at DH. The order is each player's average spot across all his 2026 starts, lowest first. No one started half the games at short (Shaw, 21), left (Kanagy, 21), DH (Rosenberger, 5), first (Gephart, 24), catcher (Stechschulte, 17) or third (Jarjis, 23), so those spots were shared. 2027 outlook is the same status used on the rest of this page.

label: lu_all
detail: Defiance used 49 different lineups in 49 games. A lineup counts as the same only with the same nine in the same order at the same positions.

label: rot_proj
detail: The same 2026 stats, with projected 2027 roles for pitchers who can return by class. Listed seniors made 13 of the 49 published starts, led by Bowman's 9.

label: Staff
detail: Main starters made at least 4 starts. Relievers made at least 5 relief outings and aren't main starters. GS and Relief are published totals.

label: Maps
detail: 35 of the 51 players with a listed hometown are from Ohio and 8 from Michigan. The others list Indiana (3), Tennessee, Ontario, Pennsylvania, Illinois and New York.

label: League
detail: Defiance ranked 5th of 11 WHAC teams in OPS (.798) and 6th in runs per game (6.00). On the mound it ranked 10th in ERA (9.92) and 11th in strikeouts per nine (6.27).

label: Method
detail: wOBA uses standard big-league weights. FIP uses a constant that sets the NAIA-wide FIP equal to NAIA ERA. Rank 1 is best in every row. Defiance's WHAC rank is out of 11 teams because Rochester Christian isn't listed. NAIA stats and Defiance's own stats can differ slightly, so a few figures here won't match its site.

label: Filter
detail: All games shows Defiance's published totals. Any other filter is added up from box scores and play-by-play, game by game. The filter changes the Hitters, Pitchers and Tendencies tabs. Player cards always show the full season.

label: Outing log
detail: Days of rest counts full calendar days since the pitcher's previous appearance, whatever the filter. Pitch counts show a dash when a box score lists none.

label: Hayden Kanagy
detail: Kanagy, a freshman outfielder, hit .440 with a 1.113 OPS and led the team with 51 hits, 13 doubles and 16 steals. Defiance says the average was the best in the WHAC among hitters with 100 or more at-bats. He was second-team All-WHAC.

label: Scoring
detail: Defiance scored 6.00 runs a game in NAIA stats, 6th of 11 in the WHAC and 127th of 179 in the NAIA. It hit 24 homers; Brubaker-Flood led with 5 and Wurster had 4. Its on-base percentage was .397, with 89 hit by pitches.

label: Run prevention
detail: The 9.92 ERA ranked 10th of 11 in the WHAC and 162nd in the NAIA. Pitchers walked 245 and struck out 239 in 343.0 innings, and opponents stole 153 bases in 168 tries. The defense made 92 errors.

label: League play
detail: Defiance went 8-20 in the WHAC and was outscored 190-293, hitting .299 with an 11.17 ERA in those 28 games. It won at least once against seven of its 10 WHAC opponents and lost every game against Aquinas, Indiana Tech and Northwestern Ohio; the four games with Indiana Tech and Northwestern Ohio were lost by 11 or more runs each.

label: Close games
detail: Defiance went 7-8 in one-run games. In the three-game stretch at Rochester Christian on Apr 24-25, it lost 8-7, 5-4 and 7-4.

label: Senior losses
detail: Listed seniors had 393 of 1760 plate appearances, led by Silvera, who hit .325 with 46 runs, and 86.2 of 343.0 innings, led by Bowman (39.2).

label: Catcher
detail: Jayden Stechschulte made 17 starts here and can return by class. Also: Logan Hudson 16 (back by class), Jimmy Steakley 16 (back by class).

label: First base
detail: Connor Gephart made 24 starts here and can return by class. Also: Kolbe VanderLeest 15 (listed senior).

label: Second base
detail: Elisa Marquez made 34 starts here and was a listed senior. Also: Bradyn Shaw 11 (back by class).

label: Shortstop
detail: Bradyn Shaw made 21 starts here and can return by class. Also: Connor Gephart 20 (back by class), Brez Zipfel 6 (back by class).

label: Third base
detail: Dominic Jarjis made 23 starts here and can return by class. Also: Logan Rosenberger 20 (back by class).

label: Outfield
detail: Anthony Silvera Jr. 43 starts (listed senior), Caleb Wurster 36 starts (back by class), Hayden Kanagy 23 starts (back by class), Jack Brubaker-Flood 21 starts (back by class), Dylan Barger 19 starts (back by class).

label: Rotation
detail: Listed seniors made 13 of the 49 published starts: Blake Bowman 9, Joseph O'Neil 3, Anthony Silvera Jr. 1. Shaw (10), Zipfel (9), Behrman (7) and Johnson (4) are back by class.

label: Bullpen
detail: Devin Delzeith 13 relief outings (back by class), Andy Yoder 13 relief outings (back by class), Colin Danek 11 relief outings (listed senior), Dillon Johnson 9 relief outings (back by class), Joseph O'Neil 8 relief outings (listed senior), Gabriel Kelly 6 relief outings (back by class). Yoder had 4 of the team's 7 saves.

label: Listed senior hitters, 10 or more at-bats
detail: Anthony Silvera Jr., Elisa Marquez, Kolbe VanderLeest.

label: Listed senior pitchers, 10 or more innings
detail: Blake Bowman (39.2 IP), Joseph O'Neil (22.0 IP), Colin Danek (20.0 IP).

label: Staff
detail: Shane Gardner, Ben Babcock, Jacob Hild and Bobby Stearns are on the staff page, the same four as the 2026 season.

label: 2027 roster
detail: Not published yet, so transfers in and out aren't known.

label: Shane Gardner, head coach
detail: Hired in July 2023 as Defiance's 34th head coach; 2027 is his fourth season. The schedule pages add up to 39-97 over his three seasons. His bio lists 269-291-1 in 12 earlier seasons as a head coach, eight at Hiwassee and four at Trinity International, with four NCCAA World Series trips at Hiwassee.

label: Ben Babcock, assistant coach
detail: His bio says he is the pitching coach and recruiting coordinator, has been with the program since November 2021 and was interim head coach in 2023.

label: Jacob Hild, graduate assistant
detail: Joined the staff in August 2025 after four seasons as a Defiance catcher. His bio says he hit .356 as a senior.

label: Bobby Stearns, volunteer assistant
detail: His staff page has no bio.

label: Hayden Kanagy
detail: Second-team All-WHAC outfielder, Defiance's first all-conference pick since joining the WHAC.

label: Connor Gephart
detail: WHAC Champions of Character team.

label: All-WHAC
detail: No other Defiance player made the first or second team, and none made the Gold Glove team or won a player award.

label: Where the roster comes from
detail: 35 of 51 list an Ohio hometown and 8 a Michigan one. Three list Indiana, and one each lists Tennessee, Ontario, Pennsylvania, Illinois and New York.

label: How players arrive
detail: From the roster's Previous School listing: 41 of 51 list no college before Defiance, 4 a two-year college (Clark State CC, Edison State, Glen Oaks CC, Prince George's CC) and 6 a four-year school (Akron, Alma, Capital, Findlay, Mount Saint Vincent, Trinity International). The roster lists one previous school per player.

label: No 2027 roster
detail: Defiance hasn't published its 2026-27 roster. Every 2027 status here comes from the 2026 class: seniors count as gone and everyone else as able to return.

label: Decisions taken from player game logs
detail: 8 decisions aren't in the box scores. Each comes from the game log on the pitcher's Defiance bio, and each also brings the pitcher to his published line: Aiden Behrman loss (Mar 28 4-14); Andy Yoder loss (Mar 22 5-6); Andy Yoder loss (Apr 14 13-14); Brez Zipfel loss (Mar 22 2-8); Brez Zipfel loss (Mar 28 6-11); Bradyn Shaw loss (Mar 29 6-10); Colin Danek loss (Apr 14 10-13); Blake Bowman win (Mar 29 13-11).

label: Runs and steals filled from box scores
detail: The bios list no runs for Zipfel and Yoder and no steal for Danek. The box scores have 3 runs for Zipfel, 1 for Yoder and a steal for Danek, which brings the player lines to the official team totals of 294 runs and 81 steals.

label: Some games have no real counts
detail: 25 of the 49 box scores have no usable counts, including every game before Mar 10, both games at Aquinas and all four at Siena Heights. Those games are left out of the count and pitch stats.

label: Official stats and box scores differ
detail: Season lines are Defiance's official ones; filters add up the box scores. Official then box score: doubles 78, 66; homers 24, 22; hit by pitch 89, 84. Steals are also short in the box scores, because some games have no play-by-play.

label: Home and away
detail: Home, away and neutral records follow Defiance's schedule listing. The Mar 14 home doubleheader with Cornerstone was played at Mercy Field in Toledo. The Apr 6 doubleheader was moved to Lawrence Tech, and Defiance lists the second game, a 17-16 win, as a home game. The four Grace games in Jasper, Ind., are neutral. Defiance played four games in Defiance and went 1-3.

label: Roster
detail: The roster lists one previous school per player. One hometown is spelled Perrsyburg and is read as Perrysburg, Ohio.

label: Map sources
detail: Hometowns are from Defiance's roster. I entered coordinates by hand, so towns are approximate. Shapes come from U.S. Census and Natural Earth.

label: Checked by arithmetic
detail: The game log adds to 15-34, 294 runs scored and 439 allowed, and to 8-20 in WHAC games, matching Defiance's official totals and NAIA stats. Every published win, loss and save is placed in a game.

label: Box scores are from NAIA stats
detail: All 49 games are on NAIA stats, captured Nov 7, 2026. Some box scores cut names short, "Anthony Silv" and "Dominic Jarj", which are read as Anthony Silvera Jr. and Dominic Jarjis.

label: Play-by-play gaps
detail: Four box scores have no play-by-play: Feb 14 Grace (Ind.) 4-9, Feb 28 Toccoa Falls (Ga.) 1-10, Feb 28 Toccoa Falls (Ga.) 2-7, Mar 1 Toccoa Falls (Ga.) 6-5. Their batting and pitching lines are in every total, but they add nothing to the tendency, count and direction numbers. The other three Grace games have only part of their play-by-play. All four Grace box scores list only eight starters with a position, so those lineups have eight spots.

label: Projections
detail: Projected lineups and staffs come from public numbers and class. Defiance has published no depth chart.

label: Commits
detail: No commit list for Defiance was checked.

label: Spray charts are partial
detail: Spray charts use 860 of Defiance's 1,257 at-bats (68%): 88% of balls in play, 69% of hits (255 of 367) and 99% of everything else (605 of 613). Strikeouts have no direction. Scorers skip the direction on hits far more often than on outs, so charts can understate hits. Zones are where the scorer placed the ball, not exact spots.

label: Direction corrected
detail: Double plays were being credited to the relay throw instead of the first fielder, and plays written with the last name first or an error by a fielder had no direction. I corrected that on Nov 4, which moved Pull, Center and Oppo a few points for some hitters and raised the direction counts.

label: Runs by inning
detail: Defiance scored most in the 3rd (53 runs) and 33 in the 1st. It scored 55 from the 7th on, though 7-inning games shorten that count.

label: Runs allowed
detail: Opponents scored most in the 2nd, 71 runs, and 202 in the first three innings.

label: Steals
detail: Play-by-play shows 59 steals of second, 11 of third and 1 of home, of 81 published.

label: Where Defiance has the edge
detail: Homers per game 0.49 to 0.40, steals per game 1.65 to 1.44.

label: Where Cleary has the edge
detail: Batting average .320 to .285, on-base percentage .433 to .397, slugging .453 to .401, OPS .886 to .798, wOBA .393 to .360, runs per game 7.69 to 6.00, walk rate 13.4% to 10.9%, strikeout rate 14.1% to 18.4%, ERA 5.70 to 9.92, FIP 6.11 to 7.85, WHIP 1.58 to 2.12, strikeouts per nine 8.53 to 6.27, walks plus hit batters per nine 7.29 to 8.90, homers allowed per nine 0.56 to 1.05, fielding percentage .968 to .938.

label: Series
detail: Cleary won the first three of four at Howell on Mar 28-29, 2026, 11-6, 14-4 and 10-6, before Defiance won 13-11. Cleary also won both 2025 meetings at Howell, 5-0 and 9-6, so Cleary leads 5-1 since Defiance joined the WHAC; the schedule pages show no earlier meetings back to 2019.

label: Mar 28: Cleary 11, Defiance 6
detail: Zipfel started for Defiance (3.0 IP, 9 ER) and Seman for Cleary (6.0 IP, 1 ER). Silvera Jr. went 3-for-4 for Defiance, and Kempainen went 2-for-2 for Cleary.

label: Mar 28: Cleary 14, Defiance 4
detail: Behrman started for Defiance (2.0 IP, 6 ER) and Lieng for Cleary (5.1 IP, 3 ER). Shaw went 2-for-3 for Defiance, and Seman went 5-for-5 for Cleary.

label: Mar 29: Cleary 10, Defiance 6
detail: Shaw started for Defiance (3.2 IP, 6 ER) and Montilla for Cleary (5.1 IP, 6 ER). Stechschulte went 1-for-1 for Defiance, and Seman went 2-for-3 for Cleary.

label: Mar 29: Defiance 13, Cleary 11
detail: Bowman started for Defiance (2.2 IP, 7 ER) and Murray for Cleary (1.2 IP, 4 ER). Gephart went 3-for-5 for Defiance, and VanderHaar went 3-for-4 for Cleary.

label: Method
detail: With All games selected, every number in this view counts all 49 games, from box scores and play-by-play. Ground outs include sacrifices and fielder's choices, and air outs include sacrifice flies.

label: Partial
detail: Scorers didn't enter these details for every game, so each number covers only part of the season. Treat them as samples. The first two tables show what's missing.

label: Splits
detail: Innings and time through the order use every plate appearance. Time through the order is each pitcher's batters faced in that game divided by nine, so substitutions can shift it slightly.

label: Splits
detail: Only plate appearances with a count listed. The count is where the plate appearance stood before its final pitch. Two strikes and Full count overlap the other rows.

label: Ground and air outs
detail: Silvera Jr. has 1.33 ground outs per air out, the most among regulars (90 or more plate appearances), and Wurster has 0.32.

label: How long arms go
detail: Shaw averages 4.3 innings a start, Zipfel 3.5, Behrman 4.1 and Johnson 3.2. Bowman, a listed senior, averaged 3.6.

label: Groundball and fly-ball arms
detail: Zipfel has 1.97 ground outs per air out, the most among pitchers with 100 batters faced, and O'Neil has 0.67.

label: First-pitch swings
detail: Among hitters with pitch data on 40 or more plate appearances, Stechschulte swings at the most first pitches, 44% on 43. Rosenberger swings at the fewest, 21% on 48. Only 24 of Defiance's 49 box scores have counts.

label: Swing and miss
detail: Gephart whiffs on 14% of swings, the fewest among hitters with pitch data on 40 or more plate appearances, and VanderLeest on 40%.

label: Direction
detail: Wurster pulls 68% of his batted balls, the most among regulars, on 50 with a direction. Shaw pulls 25%, on 105.

label: Pitch counts
detail: Shaw averages 74 pitches a start, Zipfel 58 and Behrman 83. Shaw's most was 82. Averages use only outings with a listed count.
